Name: Adorable Cottage Bathroom and furniture
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
[u]Description:[/u]
[list]
[*]Add bathroom textures to furniture via Alternative Textures (AT)[/*]
[*]Option to replace the spouse room with a bathroom using Content Patcher (CP)[/*]
[/list]
[u]Tips and Tricks[/u]
[list]
[*]To retexture items you need the paint bucket from Robin. Test it out on your oak chair, it should work.[/*]
[*]If you are struggling to find textures, buy the Texture Catalogue from Robin, this lets you search for things.[/*]
[/list]
Information for the bathroom to replace the spouse room:
[spoiler]

[u]Quick start for [CP] bathroom to replace spouse room:[/u]
[list]
[*]Extract this mod and content patcher into your mods folder (if you are confused check out this guide﻿)[/*]
[*]If you already have CP you only need one copy[/*]
[*]It's ready to play![/*]
[/list]
[u]Config guide[/u]
[list]
[*]"Keep the frogs" - Sebastian's frog tank is removed, but since bath rooms have water I left the option of keeping the frogs or not[/*]
[*]"Manual Spouseroom Selection" - the mod replaces your spouseroom automatically, but if you're using multiplayer or have multiple spouses you might want to pick exactly which spouse room is replaced[/*]
[*]"Decorated" - there's an option for a plain bathroom or one with some furniture included. The mod folder has preview images of both options and has markers to show you where to walk to change your clothes and get into the bath[/*]
[/list]
[u]Tips and tricks[/u]
[list]
[*]Can be used with or without the furniture mods[/*]
[*]Intended for PC, might work on android[/*]
[*]Working tub that can regenerate energy and health[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[u]Mods used in screenshots[/u]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9665]Unusual windows for AT[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11071]Sand Dollar wallpaper and flooring[/url]﻿﻿[/*]
[/list]

[u]Credits[/u]
[list]
[*]Some details like the bath taps are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1626]Prismuth's compact bathroom[/url]﻿[/*]
[*]Billi for a couple of the patterns I used for things like the carpet[/*]
[*]And everyone in discord who gave me feedback and help with the mod[/*]
[/list]
